risks.proof: A close-up photo of the valve and cylinder body showing no gas residue, or a photo of the cylinder being tested with a gas detector.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially unsafe or illegal, with reduced value

risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially compromised, with reduced value
